==Description==
'''Easter Assassin Charm''' is an exclusive charm introduced in [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]] as a reward for reaching Level 6 on the premium track. It had a cost of {{Bunz|150}} or {{Robux|72}}. The total cost was {{Bunz|520}} or {{Robux|282}}.

==Appearance==
'''Easter Assassin Charm''' showcases the {{Color|SpringFrenzy|SciBunny}} [[Assassin]] with two knives in its hands floating above a giant pot. It plays two knife slash sounds.

The color of the '''Easter Assassin Charm''' depends on the color of the player's name in chat, but it is purple in its preview in the inventory.

==Trivia==
*Despite being called the '''Easter Assassin Charm''', the skin it is based on is actually called the {{Color|SpringFrenzy|SciBunny}} [[Assassin]].
